function.arguments: {"observation": "The email channel has a much higher proportion of loyal customers (131 out of 326) compared to paid_search (26 out of 483), and loyal customers have significantly higher average revenue ($82.44 vs $108.09). This suggests that customer_segment is a confounder: the email campaign targeted loyal customers, who naturally spend more, so the higher revenue in the email channel may be due to targeting, not the campaign content.", "implication": "The raw comparison of average revenue by channel is confounded by customer_segment. To properly assess campaign success, we must adjust for customer_segment. The observed difference in revenue may not be due to the campaign but due to who was targeted. A fair comparison requires stratifying or standardizing by customer_segment."}
function.name: note_finding
